precedent: skill-transport 2026-07-15: a skill-body pack gave a weak reviewer no gain (H2 refuted, haiku delta -1 vs placebo delta -1). This row tests the whole kit: narrowed skill, fixed output shape, tool list, machine-checked output, with a same-length placebo.

hypotheses.text: For the same weak model and task set, the role kit (B) closes at least 50% of the gap between the current brief (A) and the strong-model ceiling (D) on at least 3 of the 6 roles.
On those roles B beats the same-length placebo kit (C) by the discordant-pair test: the gain is the kit content, not extra words.
No role gets worse with the kit (B - A > -0.10 on every role).
The effect repeats on kimi (kimi-code 2.3.0), a weak seat from another model family; reported in weak2_report, not in the verdict.

arms.name: placebo kit
arms.tools: kits/<role>/tools (same list as B: C isolates the content, not the tool surface)

seats.weak2: kimi (kimi-code 2.3.0), PM ruling 2026-11-05. Arms B and C use the kimi variant kits (kimi/kits/<role>, kimi/placebo/<role>): the method is written into the card because a custom kimi agent cannot read plugin skills or AGENTS.md; the card cap is 4096 bytes. Own subscription quota.

design.task_prompt: tasks/<role>/<id>/prompt.md is byte-identical in all arms; it ends with a one-line list of the top-level keys of the final JSON. Arms differ only in system prompt, plugin and tool list.

metrics.cell_pass: Each cell yields pass in {0,1} from its machine check (checks/check-cell.js, exit 0 = pass, 1 = miss, 2 = infra). Rates are means of pass.

reviewer.primary: defect catch: verdict FIX and a critical/major finding that matches the case predicate and cites a line inside a diff hunk
secondary: false_must_fix count (critical/major findings that do not match and cite no real line)

implementer.primary: task oracle.sh exits 0 AND red/green evidence valid (red exit != 0, green exit == 0) AND no protected path touched

verifier.primary: va grader outcome pass: declared results match the contract oracle and the clean twin, and the defect twin deviates somewhere

planner.primary: plan skeleton check: six elements, runnable acceptance, scopes exist and parallel scopes disjoint, request areas covered, dependency edge where required, no cycle, risks have dispositions

debugger.primary: hypothesis hit: root_cause file, line window and claim wording match the planted cause, >= 2 decided hypotheses, repository untouched

explorer.primary: all questions right: found/absent as expected and every positive answer has a citation whose line really holds the quoted text

estimators.discordant_pairs: B vs C over (task, rep) cells; exact one-sided binomial tail on b of b + c at p = 0.5, alpha 0.10

verdict.rule:
0. Schedule: rows are checked against the frozen schedule (arm x seat x role x task x rep from this design and tasks/manifest.json). A row outside it or a duplicate row is refused; a scheduled cell with no row counts as infra. All comparisons use exact rational arithmetic; rounded numbers in the report are display only.
Primary seat = weak1 (Haiku 5.5) for arms A, B, C; arm D = strong seat (Sonnet) with the current brief. Only rows with infra=false count.
1. Infra gate: if infra or missing cells exceed 5% of the scheduled cells of any arm on its primary seat (weak1 for A, B, C; strong for D) after one re-run, the verdict is INCONCLUSIVE_INFRA and nothing else is computed. Infra on weak2 is reported and never blocks the verdict.
2. Per role r and arm X, s_X(r) = mean over tasks of (mean over reps of pass). A task with no non-infra row in any of A, B, C, D is dropped from that role in all arms.
3. Headroom: if s_D(r) - s_A(r) < 0.15 the role is "no_headroom": it is reported and counts neither as a pass nor as a fail.
4. gap_closed(r) = (s_B(r) - s_A(r)) / (s_D(r) - s_A(r)).
5. Discordant pairs B vs C: over (task, rep) cells present in both arms, b = #(B pass, C fail), c = #(B fail, C pass). B_beats_C(r) iff b > c and the exact one-sided binomial tail P(X >= b | n = b + c, p = 0.5) <= 0.10.
6. role_pass(r) = headroom ok AND gap_closed(r) >= 0.50 AND B_beats_C(r).
7. harm(r) = s_B(r) - s_A(r) <= -0.10.
8. Verdict: SHIP_CANDIDATE iff the number of role_pass roles >= 3 AND no role has harm; otherwise NOT_SHIP. The second weak seat (weak2, kimi) is computed with the same arithmetic but reported in a separate table (weak2_report) and is read by nothing in rules 1 to 8: it can neither confirm nor veto the verdict.

exclusions: A task whose frozen files no longer match tasks/manifest.json is excluded before the run and the row is void until restamped.
A cell with infra=true is never scored as a miss and never as a pass; it is re-run once, and a second infra stays infra.
No cell is dropped for being a bad answer: parse failure, wrong schema and wrong content all score pass=0.
infra_failure: auth or quota error from the runner (the campaign stops at the first one, exit 4 like the skill-onoff runners)
runner crash, timeout with no model output, empty transcript
kit not applied: init system prompt, tool list or plugin skill differs from the compiled kit (kit_applied=false) in a B or C cell
check-cell.js exit 2 (task files missing, workdir not a git repo, oracle cannot run, verifier case drifted from its frozen envelope)

cost.cap_note: 75 USD total for the whole A/B, pilot spend included (operator d-c76529c3)
stop_loss: stop the campaign when booked cost reaches cap_usd
after 10% of the cells, stop and report if the projected total exceeds cap_usd
a stop is recorded as INCONCLUSIVE_INFRA with the cells done; it is never silently resumed past the cap

preconditions.text: Before the formal run, one minimal real-model call per kit shows the model follows the role card: a throwaway copy of the compiled card carries a nonce instruction; the evidence is the runner session record (system prompt hash and tool list equal the compiled kit, kit_applied=true) plus a reply that contains the nonce. Needs G37 account registration (d-2a19fdb5).

The same check, done the same way, on kimi with the kimi variant kit (--agent-file, tools in the agent file). The spike so far proves injection and the tool list from the session record only; whether the model follows the card is unverified.

preconditions_gate: stamp-rolekit.js refuses to stamp this row unless prereg/preconditions-formal.json lists every precondition id with met=true and a non-empty evidence path; the file is part of the frozen set. A cost of these calls counts against the 75 USD cap.

seats_not_used.reason: without credentials agy cannot create a request (it asks for OAuth first), so neither the injected card nor the tool list can be observed; a non-empty tool allowlist cannot be discovered with zero calls; the old empty-allowlist evidence is from earlier agy versions. Not a candidate until a verified check exists.
